name: Holiness
overview: Scripture reveals holiness as God's defining nature and the standard He sets for His people, calling them to be distinct and consecrated for His purposes. From God's command to Abram to "walk before me, and be thou perfect" (Genesis 17:1), to Israel being called "a kingdom of priests, and an holy nation" (Exodus 19:6), holiness involves being set apart through moral purity and dedication. The inscriptions "HOLINESS TO THE LORD" on the high priest's crown (Exodus 28:36; 39:30) symbolize this sacred separation. Believers are called to reject what is unclean and live lives reflecting God's purity, embodying the holy character He alone possesses.
